mapper.select: SELECT * FROM session WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT * FROM session WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session (session_no, customer_id, agent_id, skill_group_id, status, transfer_from, priority_score) VALUES (#{sessionNo}, #{customerId}, #{agentId}, #{skillGroupId}, #{status}, #{transferFrom}, #{priorityScore})
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE session SET agent_id = #{agentId}, status = #{status}, assigned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE session SET agent_id = #{agentId}, status = 'ASSIGNED', assigned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE session SET skill_group_id = #{skillGroupId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE session SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'ACTIVE')
SELECT status FROM session WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM session WHERE status = 'TRANSFERRING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{olderThanMinutes} MINUTE)
